Definition: from a derivative of G4141 (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate:--behead.
BiblicalUsage: Pelekizo means to behead, to cut off the head with an axe. John saw the souls of those beheaded for the witness of Jesus and for the word of God, who had not worshipped the beast or taken his mark, and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that the axe cannot end what God has begun: those beheaded for the witness lived and reigned with Christ.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
